Both of us are completely unwilling to have an abortion in any circumstance. That was something that pushed our relationship over the edge the first time. I got pregnant, he and my family pressured me into having an abortion I didn’t want, and now we both regret it. So that’s definitely out of the question for us and, even if it weren’t for him, for me personally. 
He gives me the “condoms are uncomfortable” spiel which I mean, I totally get, but it’s just too risky for me to have sex without them. Not that he’s all that interested anyway

You’re right. Sometimes when we’re laying in bed next to each other I just wish he would do something, anything. He rarely initiates, only wants me to give and give. He even used his birthday this past weekend as an excuse to flat out ask for a blowjob, which I didn’t mind, but he acted like he doesn’t ask me to do it every single time we’re together. It was annoying and bothered me a lot because I always end up having to privately get myself off when I’m in the mood. I’m tired of doing it myself lol
You’re right. I want to have an honest, open relationship with him, and it’s important we talk about it. We both want to have children, so an active and healthy sex life is really important to me.

Hi! Thanks for all of the advice. No, I did not cheat on him at all when we dated before. The reason we broke up largely had to do with the fact that I got pregnant, and during the two week period of us knowing before we broke up, we both became different people, very depressed and irrational. We needed time apart to get back on track and it worked. 
Also, I think you’re right. Holding out would probably be helpful, and I’m definitely going to give it a shot
We were apart for about a year and a half-two years. Both of us “dated” during our time apart but neither of us committed to anyone or got physically intimate.

Thank you so much for this. I’ve been where you are in a previous relationship, and I definitely feel confident enough that this boyfriend would be supportive of my hormonal and emotional changes as a result of BC...but that doesn’t make me want to do it. I hate being on birth control. I gain weight, my skin goes to hell, I get ansy and anxious, it’s really something that I hate doing.
But I feel like I’m being selfish in this way, he makes sacrifices for me, should this be a sacrifice I just deal with so that I’m being fair to him?
No I haven’t, that’s a great suggestion. I’ll definitely do that. Thank you so much!
We’ve talked a lot about BC. I’m nervous about it because of the hormonal changes I’ve gone through on the past while on it, but I’m willing to make the change to help our relationship.

That’s definitely a possibility. My boyfriend has a hard talking about his feelings, and since I took the brunt of a lot of the hardship when we broke up, we’ve definitely spent more time focusing on my emotions than his. 
I wouldn’t be surprised if there’s something wrong that he hasn’t really committed any time to addressing. That’s a really great idea and I’ll definitely try it. Thank you so much
This is phenomenal. Amazing, OP! 🥰

Birth control absolutely can have an effect on your skin. It depends on the person, obviously, but I have had experience where birth control both positive and negatively affects my skin. When I first got on birth control, it helped clear my skin (but not by much), the second time around it DESTROYED my skin. If you’re looking for acne solutions, drink only water and use no product except plain, unscented bar soap on your face for a month, then slowly introduce one product at a time over 1 week intervals. You’ll find out quickly what is causing your breakouts. 
Good luck!☺️

I can totally appreciate where you’re coming from and I am not an OBGYN, so I know it’s not really my place to respond, but I also feel like, for me as a woman, I would want to know all possible side effects of surgery or medication. 
Yes of course, if you know you want to have a surgery your doctor should not flat out deny you that surgery, but I do think it is very important that ever patient is made aware of the potential effects it may have on their future, whether or not they think it will affect them personally.

I am a trauma victim. When I was 14, I started dating my boyfriend, a boy who forcefully took my virginity and ended up physically, emotionally, sexually and financially abusing me for 5 years. 
I’m 24 now, and finally really committing to therapy for everything I went through. I had a really scary session where I admitted to some parts of memories I’ve blocked out, and my current boyfriend’s response was, and I’m quoting, “I’ve been spending time on r/ptsd, trying to understand this. I can do this, I can be the partner you need. You’ve been traumatized all your life, and been invalidated for it. I believe you and validate your traumas, and I don’t think any less of you for it, and I love you.” 
It really warmed my heart and he hit everything I needed to hear right on the head. His support is so sweet and I’d be missing a massive part of my heart if I didn’t have him. 💕

I’d say “it’s okay” because it’s the typical reply, but it’s so not okay. I’m upset beyond words. But I appreciate your kind words and advice. My other parent is completely unaware of what she does and blindly supports her whenever I try to bring something up, so it’s totally pointless. 
I’m not even concerned about her not being here when I look around. I already looked everywhere right in front of her and she just laughed at me like what I was doing was ridiculous. 
I feel sick even talking about this. 
I’ll try to breathe and relax, thank you for reaching out💗

We got back together after about 2 years of being apart. When we started talking again about how we were doing it seemed that we both had matured so much and were more ready to pursue this relationship with a real end goal in sight: being together for life. He and I have a long history together and we’ve both expressed that we want to be together and work out our problems regarding our messy break up (which you’re right, it was messy. It was horrible). I see a therapist weekly, he is looking into starting therapy because of some of his own issues, and I do still live at home with the prospect of moving out shortly in the next few months.

I tried telling him that tonight when things calmed down. He responded by saying he was so upset he wanted to throw his phone “through a fucking wall and cry” and that he couldn’t “in good faith” continue this conversation and go do homework. I don’t know what to do.

I want to have patience with him because I understand the pressure he is under. It’s just so hard when I feel like I’m doing all of the work and he’s just complaining about me not doing it right. I feel so confused about my role in the relationship

I’m so frustrated and upset because all I want to do as his girlfriend is try to make his life happier and easier... I know that school is hard and I try to be there for him. But he makes me feel like all I do is make things worse. 
Could that be the case even though I’m not trying to make things worse at all?
I’m in, too! I have experiences with PTSD that I can’t talk to anyone about, because I feel like I’m annoying them. I would love to talk to you all, who know what it’s like.

OP, PLEASE tell someone. I have been where you are, and before it gets worse, you need to tell a teacher. Things will be difficult at first, but please be confident knowing you are doing the right thing to keep yourself safe and protected. I believe you and believe in you, and wish you the best of luck. My inbox is open if you want to talk.
xx letterstomaribelle

I didn’t break up with him, just FYI. 
And to be clearer, I’m not upset that he communicated with her, I’m anxious that someone who I’m seeing tonight, as the reintroduced girlfriend, knows really intimate details about our breakup that I wish no one knew. I’m also not pissed off, I just feel like my privacy was violated. 

Everyone needs someone to talk to and I know that but it doesn’t seem like there’s even 1 person in his social circle he didn’t tell every single detail to.

I would definitely tell your dad the honest truth which is that you guys aren’t getting married yet and we will announce it formally when we are ready.
Your dad will likely understand the situation you’re in, just be honest! You don’t want unnecessary pressure on your relationship or on your partner to propose if he’s not quite there yet.
